import itertools
def invnum(seq):
    N=len(seq)
    res=0
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(i+1,N):
            if seq[i]>seq[j]:
                res+=1
    return res
def naive(N,k,flag):
    res=0
    for p in itertools.permutations(range(N),N):
        for q in itertools.permutations(range(N),N):
            if ((p<q) or (not(flag))) and (invnum(p)-invnum(q)>k):
                res+=1

def solve(N,k,flag):
    if k in memo[N][flag]:

    '''
    長さNの順列
    invnum(p)-invnum(q)>kとなる場合の数

import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static int n;
    static long mod;
    static Map<Integer, Long>[] memoTrue;
    static Map<Integer, Long>[] memoFalse;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        if (!sc.hasNextInt()) return;
        n = sc.nextInt();
        mod = sc.nextLong();

        memoTrue = new HashMap[n + 1];
        memoFalse = new HashMap[n + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            memoTrue[i] = new HashMap<>();
            memoFalse[i] = new HashMap<>();
        }

        System.out.println(solve(n, 0, true));
    }

    static long solve(int N, int k, boolean flag) {
        if (flag) {
            if (memoTrue[N].containsKey(k)) return memoTrue[N].get(k);
        } else {
            if (memoFalse[N].containsKey(k)) return memoFalse[N].get(k);
        }

        long res;
        if (N == 1) {
            if (flag) {
                res = 0;
            } else {
                res = (k < 0) ? 1 : 0;
            }
        } else {
            int invnumINF = (N * (N - 1)) / 2;
            if (k < -invnumINF - 1) {
                res = solve(N, -invnumINF - 1, flag);
            } else if (k >= invnumINF) {
                res = 0;
            } else {
                res = 0;
                for (int delta = -N + 1; delta < N; delta++) {
                    if (flag && delta > 0) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    long wt = Math.min(N - delta, delta + N);
                    boolean nextFlag = (delta == 0) && flag;
                    res = (res + solve(N - 1, k - delta, nextFlag) * wt) % mod;
                }
            }
        }

        if (flag) {
            memoTrue[N].put(k, res);
        } else {
            memoFalse[N].put(k, res);
        }
        return res;
    }
}
